      dockerfile: Dockerfile.bot
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      - LOAN_WATCH_STATE_PATH=/app/data/loan_watch_state.json
      - LOAN_WATCH_OUTBOX_DIR=/app/data/outbox

      - ./data:/app/data
    command: ["sh", "-c", "while true; do python -m bot loan-watch --once || echo \\"loan-watch 失敗 $$?\\"; sleep
$${LOAN_WATCH_INTERVAL:-600}; done"]

  frontend:''',1)
